basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old IT technician from Austin, Texas, who recently discovered the fascinating world of cryptocurrency. I have a deep interest in technology and often find myself tinkering with hardware and software in my free time. Besides crypto, I am passionate about mental health awareness, especially regarding bipolar disorder, as I have personal experience managing it. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST. Currently single, I enjoy spending my weekends hiking with my rescue dog, Luna. Not a fan of overly formal environments or long meetings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in cryptocurrency is still in its infancy, largely self-acquired through online forums, articles, and a few YouTube videos. I have a stronger foundation in computer hardware and software, thanks to my job and years of self-teaching.
